messages:
maria: Quick q — customer ACME (priv-VPC) needs to rotate their Grafana API key and update Prometheus remote_write creds. Anyone got the shortest playbook?

raj: For Grafana keys we keep the canonical secret in Vault at secret/privvpc/acme/grafana. Rotation steps in the onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/privvpc/onboarding (see "key rotation"). TL;DR: create new key in Grafana -> write to Vault -> update any push configs.

kevin: If they're pushing via prometheus remote_write to our ingest endpoint, here's the usual snippet they add on their side (replace vault ref):

```
remote_write:
  - url: https://ingest.priv.redwood.acme/prometheus/remote_write
    basic_auth:
      username: acme-prom
      password: <vault:secret/privvpc/acme/prom_rw_token>
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem
```
Make sure the token in Vault has metadata tag `prom_rw` so our validator picks it up.

sarah: After you update Vault, run the validator endpoint: `POST /v1/privvpc/validate-remote-write` with the vault path in the body. It will try a test write and return diagnostics (bad auth / tls errors / label conflicts).

maria: Perfect — how do I find their Grafana dashboard to spot-check panels after rotation?

raj: Dashboards are at the customer Grafana host: https://grafana.priv.redwood/acme/dashboards. Direct link to the overview: https://grafana.priv.redwood/acme/d/overview (might require SSO). If they report 403, check the org membership or the grafana-proxy logs.

kevin: grafana-proxy logs are forwarded to our private logs cluster. Search `cluster:acme-proxy` and `component:grafana-proxy` in the logs UI. Query example: `resource.labels.cluster_name="acme-proxy" AND jsonPayload.component="grafana-proxy"`

deploy-bot: deployment acme-grafana-proxy/rollout succeeded — 3 pods ready (img v2.3.1) :white_check_mark:

kevin: Note alerting: rotations frequently trigger `GrafanaKeyChangeDetected` or `PromRemoteWriteAuthFail`. Before rotating, add a 10m silence on those alerts (Grafana -> Alerting -> Silences) so we don't flood pager. After validation, remove silence.

maria: One more — if TLS fails on their side (self-signed), do we accept custom CA?

raj: Yes, we accept custom CA for priv-VPC. They need to include CA bundle in their prometheus TLS config and tag the vault creds with `accept_custom_ca=true`. Our validator will report the CA mismatch otherwise.

maria: Awesome, thanks all. I'll do the rotation now and ping back with the validator output. :thumbsup:
